artifacts.summary: 9-phase plan (4 dependency waves, ~11h) for the per-task issues.jsonl contract, the single issue-record.sh writer, dispatch/contract threading, seven orchestrator-side call sites, the six recorded relation verdicts, and the reflection-field retirement.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent system, a per-dispatch instruction that must reach every dispatched agent is threaded at ONE point -- the single brace-grouped section emitter in scripts/orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh that writes the dispatch file -- never by editing agent definition files (there are ~78). Within that emitter, sections split into unconditional (Identity, Description, Artifact Round, Handoff, Wait Discipline, User-Decision Contract) and conditional (Territory, memory/lit/effort/hard-contracts, Prior Decisions, phase-specific artifact blocks). Placing a new section among the unconditional ones is what makes it reach research, plan, and implement phases alike; placing it in a conditional branch silently limits coverage. The shared contract includes are NOT equivalent substitutes: context/contracts/phase-closure.md is loaded in both modes via an explicit @-bullet in the general implementation agent, but context/contracts/wrap-up.md is hard-mode-only, so an instruction placed only there never reaches standard-mode or research/plan dispatches. Verify an addition by generating a dispatch file for all three phase values, not by reading the code.
